calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_sales_keys,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_sales_line_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_return_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (o.web_order_id IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))) AS web_lines_without_dispatched_order,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test') AS web_test_lines

calls.statement:
WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, MIN(f.sale_date) AS mn, MAX(f.sale_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS keys, COUNT(*) AS lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l2
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS test_net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = COALESCE(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE), f.sale_date)
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
